thesis: Jayemdae Tome represents the old control bargain: invest four mana now and four more each time to turn spare late-game mana into inevitable cards.

playbook.role: Deploy it only after stabilizing, then activate at the opponent's end step when interaction was not needed. The Tome is strongest in attrition games where mana would otherwise go unused.
